items.title: What Needs To Be True To Buy Twist Bioscience Stock Now?
items.summary: A $10,000 holding in Twist Bioscience (TWST) a year ago is worth about $66,600 today. The same sum in the S&P 500 would be worth about $11,700. The company sells made-to-order DNA to drug makers and research labs. Its sales grow fast, but it still loses money. The price now counts on that growth lasting and the losses ending. How much has to go right for that price to hold.

items.title: Illumina (ILMN) Tests Valuation As Russell Index Removal Forces A Fresh Look
items.summary: Index removal puts Illumina in focus Illumina (ILMN) has been removed from the Russell Small Cap Value Index, an index reshuffle that can prompt mechanical selling and raise fresh questions about how the stock is being valued today. The index removal comes at a time when Illumina’s momentum is already strong, with a 1-day share price return of 7.25%, a 30-day share price return of 21.82% and a year-to-date share price return of 103.87%.
